title: Neuralink Patient Plays Video Games With His Mind
description: First human Neuralink patient demonstrates ability to control computer cursor and play games using only brain signals. The cyberpunk future isn't coming — it's here.

title: Tokyo at Night
description: The neon-drenched streets of Shinjuku — indistinguishable from concept art.

title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Now Indistinguishable From Reality
description: New research shows humans can no longer reliably distinguish AI-generated faces and voices from real ones. Identity is now a question mark.

title: We Have Megacorps
content: Five companies control most of what you see, buy, and think. They have more power than most governments. They operate above the law. They surveil billions. This isn't dystopian fiction — it's your Tuesday.

title: Cybertruck On The Streets
description: Low-poly vehicles straight out of a PS1 fever dream are now real consumer products.

title: Cities Deploy Facial Recognition Despite Bans
description: Multiple cities quietly deploying real-time facial recognition surveillance networks in public spaces, bypassing existing moratoriums.

title: The Gig Economy Is Just Day Labor With An App
content: No benefits. No stability. An algorithm decides if you eat this week. But hey, you're your own boss. Welcome to the future of work — same exploitation, sleeker interface.

title: Gene-Edited Babies: Second Known Case Confirmed
description: Scientists confirm a second case of CRISPR-edited human embryos brought to term. Designer babies are no longer hypothetical.

title: Robot Dogs Patrol San Francisco
description: Boston Dynamics robots now patrol corporate campuses and city streets. Fully autonomous. Armed with cameras. Definitely not dystopian at all.

title: Billionaire Builds Underground Bunker City
description: Tech billionaire completes construction of a self-sustaining underground compound in New Zealand. Capacity: 5,000 people. The rich are preparing for the collapse they're causing.

title: Hong Kong Density
description: Stacked living units stretching into infinity. Blade Runner called it — we just call it rent.

title: Your Fridge Snitches On You
content: Smart refrigerators now track your eating habits and share data with insurance companies. Your appliances work for corporations. You pay for the privilege. This is fine.

title: Brain-Computer Interface Lets Paralyzed Woman Speak Again
description: A brain implant translates neural signals directly into speech at 62 words per minute. The line between human and machine blurs further.

title: Amazon Workers Tracked By AI Every Second Of Their Shift
description: Warehouse workers monitored by AI systems that track bathroom breaks, hand movements, and 'time off task' down to the second.

title: Reminder
content: Cyberpunk was supposed to be a warning, not a roadmap.
